articles.title: Arrow Exploration, Frontier IP, RC365, Coiled Therapeutics, Genflow, Pan African Resources
articles.summary: Arrow Exploration Corp (TSX-V:AXL, AIM:AXL, OTC:CSTPF) has brought its Icaco-2 well in Colombia on production at around 830 barrels per day gross, taking total corporate output to approximately 5,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day. CEO Marshall Abbott says the Icaco discovery "may be material to Arrow," with horizontal and vertical development wells already planned. Frontier IP Group PLC (LSE:FIPP, FRA:8WT) has raised £4 million through a placing and subscription at 12p per share, with six directors participating in the subscription element. A retail offer through BookBuild is also open, aiming to raise a further £400,000 before closing at 5pm on 18 June. RC365 Holding PLC (LSE:RCGH, FRA:L2G) has signed a point-of-sale agreement with StarCruises International to deploy its RC3.0 payments platform across cruise operations in Asia. The platform includes cryptocurrency acceptance and multi-language support. Coiled Therapeutics (AIM:COIL, OTCQB:COTXF) has appointed two senior oncologists to a newly formed medical advisory board guiding its lead cancer drug AO-252 through phase I trials. Professor Guru Sonpavde and Dr Alexander Spira will shape clinical strategy as the programme moves toward expansion cohorts in the second half of 2026. Genflow Biosciences Ltd (LSE:GENF, OTCQB:GENFF, FRA:WQ5) has been invited to present results from its SLAB dog longevity study at the Animal Longevity Summit in Toronto in October. The study evaluating its SIRT6 gene therapy in aged beagles concludes this month. Pan African Resources PLC (LSE:PAF, OTCQX:PAFRY, JSE:PAN) will join the FTSE 250 from 23 June, following the court sanction of its all-share acquisition of Emmerson Resources. The gold producer also joins the FTSE 350, FTSE All-Share and related indices. Follow us and subscribe to YouTube, our social channels, and on proactiveinvestors.co.uk.
